title: New AJAX export handler without a capability check
description: A plugin adds an AJAX endpoint that exports subscriber e-mail addresses. The request nonce and SQL handling are correct, but the handler performs no capability check.
context: add_action('wp_ajax_...') registers the handler for any logged-in user, including subscribers. The client sends a valid wfb_export_subscribers nonce. There is no shared permission wrapper in this plugin; each handler performs its own capability check.

expected_findings.description: The new wp_ajax_wfb_export_subscribers handler exports subscriber e-mail addresses without a current_user_can() capability check, so any logged-in user with a valid nonce can call it.

notes: The nonce is verified and the query is correctly prepared. The only intended defect is the missing capability authorization check; reporting CSRF or SQL injection is a false positive.
